{
  "phoneNote": "Well-structured, calm mobile page where the hero photo, forest-green color palette, and clear pricing list immediately suit an outdoor camp.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero text box is pushed so far down that the body copy and primary CTA are clipped by the bottom of the 800px viewport.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero image height or overlap the dark text card higher up so the full intro text and 'Poglejte cene' link fit inside the first screen.",
    "Add contact or booking links to the sparse top header bar on desktop to balance the layout and give visitors immediate access to key sections.",
    "Reorder the sections so the camp's story and facility photos appear before the utilitarian 'Obiščite nas' contact cards."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On the desktop first screen, the hero text card extends past the bottom of the viewport, cutting off the descriptive copy and hiding the call-to-action link."
  ]
}
